[[File:Players Committee organization chart 2024.png|thumb|right|520px|alt=Players Committee organization chart: the Lead Advocate, six advocates and their volunteer teams|Players Committee organization chart]]
The [[Players Committee]] (PC) is led by the [[Lead Advocate]] and an Advocate Council. Each advocate oversees the volunteer teams for one area of the game: rules and technology, marketing, design, production, tournaments or communications. The Community Card of March 2026 adds an eighth council seat, [[Event Organization Advocate|Event Organization]], held by [[Karl Koenig]], who appears on the chart in the Outreach Team.<ref name="card2026">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Communitycard.html Community Card, Advocate Council tab], res.starwarsccg.org (file dated 18 March 2026)</ref> Past advocates are listed on [[Players Committee advocates]].
